units.source_text: 源氏公子回左大臣邸后，全然不能成寐。

en.t: After Prince Genji returned to the Minister of the Left's residence, he could not sleep at all.

units.source_text: 他回忆葵姬年来模样，想道：“为什么我一直认为将来自能得她谅解，总是满不在乎地任情而动，使得她心怀怨恨呢？

en.t: He remembered how Lady Aoi had been over the years and thought, "Why did I always assume that someday she would surely understand me, and so act willfully without concern, making her bear resentment toward me?

units.source_text: 她终身把我看作一个冷酷无情的薄倖郎，抱恨而死了！”

en.t: All her life she saw me as a cold, heartless, faithless man, and she died with that bitterness in her heart!"

units.source_text: 他历历回想，后悔之事甚多，然而悔之晚矣！

en.t: As he recalled everything vividly, there were many things he regretted, but it was already too late for regret.

units.source_text: 他穿上了浅黑色丧服，似觉身在梦境，想入非非：

en.t: He put on pale black mourning clothes and, feeling as though he were in a dream, let his thoughts wander.

units.source_text: “如果我比她先死，她一定穿深黑色的丧服吧。”

en.t: "If I had died before her, she would surely have worn deep black mourning clothes."
